description: Scaffold a design docs project after the tree is approved.
prompt: Use the doc-kit skill. Set up a design docs project for my game Hollowreach in this folder, with the design preset. Owner is Jonah. Systems: Archery (code ARC) and Stamina (code STA), each with a spec file. The tree you would propose is approved, so go ahead and create it, and run the lint until it is clean.

assertions.desc: README.md, docs/CONVENTIONS.md, docs/SYSTEM_MAP.md, docs/GLOSSARY.md, tools/doclint.py, tools/doclint.json and tools/hooks/pre-commit exist.
No YYYY-MM-DD, <OWNER>, <Project name> or <generated table> placeholder is left outside docs/templates.
ARC and STA are in the code table of CONVENTIONS.md.
Both specs exist with matching front matter ids.
The system map lists ARC and STA in a generated table.
The owner placeholder in CONVENTIONS.md is replaced by Jonah.
